mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_log (operator, operator_id, role, ip, method, operation, params, status, cost_ms, create_time) VALUES (#{operator}, #{operatorId}, #{role}, #{ip}, #{method}, #{operation}, #{params}, #{status}, #{costMs}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, operator, operator_id, role, ip, method, operation, params, status, cost_ms, create_time FROM sys_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
